start_ray_cluster_on_slurm: start a Ray cluster with head and worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster and start_head_and_workers
start_ray_head_node: start the Ray head node on SLURM using RayCluster.start_head with resource requirements
start_ray_worker_nodes: start an array of Ray worker nodes on SLURM using RayCluster.start_workers after head is ready
manage_ray_cluster_state: manage Ray cluster state and rendezvous info using RayClusterState to track head and worker jobs
shutdown_ray_cluster: shutdown a Ray cluster and cancel all SLURM jobs using RayCluster.shutdown
